newsitem.title: UK: AVIS EUROPE TO BE FLOATED FOR 700 MLN STG - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: AVIS EUROPE TO BE FLOATED FOR 700 MLN STG - PAPER.

text.p: Car hire company Avis Europe will be floated on the London stock exchange in March with an expected value of 700 million pounds ($1.15 billion), a British newspaper said on Monday.
The Daily Telegraph said shareholders had spent nearly a year considering different options for the company after a merger with its former American parent Avis was ruled out.
Belgian car importer and distributor D'Ieteren , which owns 77.1 percent of Avis Europe, said earlier this month it would decide in February whether or not to list Avis Europe.
Avis Europe was floated in London in 1986. It was bought three years later by D'Ieteren-controlled Cilva Holdings Plc. ($1=.6097 Stg).
